# Clarify the fictional civic-lantern study period

## What changed

The imaginary study period is stated explicitly.

## Why it changed

The fictional wording now gives readers a complete pretend timeframe.

## Previous wording

The fictional municipality will study blue paper lanterns in one imaginary park.

## New wording

The fictional municipality will study blue paper lanterns in one imaginary park for one imaginary week.

## Effect on the commitment

This is a clarification with no material change to the imaginary commitment.

## What did not change

The fictional location, lantern colour, paper material and publication items remain unchanged.
